items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: That man killed Gagli. Walter Decker.

ctx.x: You don't recall Booker? He was an old time musician. And he'd been in the local for years. He was working. No, he wasn't working at the time of Gagli killed the... That man killed Gagli. Walter Decker. Yeah, he wasn't working. He wasn't working there then. Mm-hmm. They had laid the bass off. Because this thing got bad and he wasn't working there. But he was the whole bass player there at the Budweiser at that time. But anyway...
Where did you get your first bass then? Uh...
